units.source_text: “就这么办吧，您特意同我们做伴，

en.t: Let us do that, then. You were kind enough to keep us company,

units.source_text: 我却自行决定延期，实在对不起……

en.t: and yet I decided on my own to postpone things. I am truly sorry...

units.source_text: 不过，明天不论发生什么情况，我们也得启程。

en.t: Still, no matter what happens tomorrow, we must set out.

units.source_text: 因为我们的宝宝在旅途中夭折了，后天是七七，老早就打算在下田做七七了。

en.t: Our baby died on the journey, and the day after tomorrow is the forty-ninth day memorial; we had long planned to hold it in Shimoda.

units.source_text: 我们这么匆匆赶路，就是要赶在这之前到达下田。

en.t: That is why we have been hurrying along, so that we can reach Shimoda before then.

units.source_text: 也许跟您谈这些有点失礼，看来我们特别有缘分。

en.t: Perhaps it is a little rude to tell you all this, but it seems we have a special connection.

units.source_text: 后天也请您参加拜祭吧。”

en.t: Please join us for the memorial service the day after tomorrow as well.
